data.name: The drone's role: Orchestrators select drones by matching roles. Cargo drone: logistics jobs. Ore hauler: logistics of ores / ice only, and takes nothing else (plus mining). Welder / Grinder / Welder + grinder drone: weld / grind jobs. Mining drone: mining jobs. Ore scout: the industrial designator's scout jobs, and only those drones (needs an ore detector). Combat drone: the hostile designator's engage / escort jobs, and only those drones (needs AI Defensive, AI Flight and AI Offensive). Managed by orchestrator, it also launches on its own detections. Farming drone: not implemented yet. Rover: wheeled (not implemented yet). Combat drones, ore scouts and ore haulers may dock with small connectors; others need a standard one. Every section below can be unfolded whatever the profile.
